busy: the session is already in a turn
internal: the server hit an internal error
effort_unsupported: this model takes no thinking effort
effort_not_declared: this model does not take that thinking effort
cwd_unusable: that is not a usable working directory
delete_busy: the session is running a turn; interrupt it before deleting
child_session: a child session cannot do that
writer_required: only the session's writer may write
memo_empty: this session holds no blocks yet
retention_bad: retention is neither chars nor blocks
no_archive: the session has no request archive
payload_key_missing: a required field is missing or malformed
range_outside: the blocks are not one range of this session
